steps: Open the local static artifact over HTTP with a clean browser context at 1200×900, en-US, UTC.
Fix Date to 2026-11-05T05:00:00Z for the public game’s time-based cave seed; animation remains real-time.
Hold D for 2200 ms to walk through the upper passage; aim right and hold the mouse to cast for 350 ms.
Release the mouse, hold D for another 1800 ms toward the first descent, then select wand 2 and cast toward the lower-right for 250 ms; wait 500 ms.
